scenarios.title: Escalate an acute rhythm-control event
scenarios.intent: Assert that Margaret is still admitted, record a clinically significant change across nested vitals, raise acuity, rewrite the care summary, and append the corresponding audit event as one atomic command.
techniques: assert(...) checks a multi-field baseline before any write
Nested scalar paths update several contained vital-sign leaves
Sequential statements form one all-or-nothing mutation
append(...) creates a contained audit event
del(...[* predicate]) removes every matching audit event on reverse

scenarios.title: Titrate Warfarin and hold the next dose
scenarios.intent: Select exactly one medication by clinical identity, increase its dose without replacing the medication object, change its administration state, and record why. A stale or ambiguous medication match rejects the whole edit.
techniques: select(...) requires exactly one containsMany match
|= performs an in-place arithmetic dose update
Sibling fields change together without replacing the medication
append(...) records the clinical reason
Forward and reverse assertions reject stale state

scenarios.title: Place every administered medication on transfer hold
scenarios.intent: Use the visible bulk marker to update every currently administered medication while preserving dose, timing, and all sibling fields. An empty match is an error rather than a false success.
techniques: [* predicate] explicitly selects every matching contained record
One-or-more bulk mutation fails when nothing matches
Only administration state changes; sibling medication data survives
Audit append and bulk cleanup remain atomic

scenarios.title: Post a cardioversion and its pharmacy charge
scenarios.intent: Increment two nested billing leaves in reading order. The Card's computed total updates without BXL touching or duplicating that derived field, then an audit event explains the coordinated charge.
techniques: Sequential |= arithmetic updates two billing leaves
The Card model recomputes the derived total outside BXL
Multiple nested values commit as one write
assert(...) protects the expected billing snapshot
append(...) and bulk del(...) maintain the audit trail

scenarios.pattern: Insert contained item by stable anchor
scenarios.title: Insert fall precautions beside mobility care
scenarios.intent: Insert a complete contained instruction immediately after the stable Mobility anchor. The surrounding ordered care plan is not rebuilt, and reverse deletes by meaning rather than array position.
techniques: insert_item_after(...) performs a surgical ordered insertion
select(...) finds a stable semantic anchor instead of an index
An inline object constructs the new contained record
Unrelated care-plan items retain identity and order
Bulk del(...) reverses by meaning rather than position
scenarios.viewerLabel: Jordan Blake, RN · cardiac night nurse

scenarios.pattern: Move contained item by stable anchors
scenarios.title: Promote mobility to the first care priority
scenarios.intent: Move the complete Mobility instruction before Meals without replacing the array. Its status, instruction, schedule, and FieldDef metadata travel together as one structural intent.
techniques: move_item_before(...) reorders a containsMany collection
Two select(...) expressions identify stable semantic anchors
The contained item moves intact with all nested fields
reorder_by(...) restores canonical baseline order
assert(...) verifies both forward and reverse ordering
scenarios.viewerLabel: Jordan Blake, RN · cardiac night nurse

scenarios.title: Draft a discharge summary from the live care plan
scenarios.intent: Deep-copy the current care summary into a distinct discharge field, then transform only the copy. Later care-plan edits cannot mutate the draft by aliasing.
techniques: copy_value_to(source; destination) deep-copies source data
The copied value does not alias the original field
Later statements transform only the destination
Null and non-null assertions make apply and reverse safe

scenarios.title: Reorder and expand a multidisciplinary consult team
scenarios.intent: Move the emergency physician ahead of the pharmacist by stable Card identity, then append an ICU nurse and cardiac night nurse. The adapter emits one relationship move and two relationship inserts while maintaining JSON:API keys.
techniques: move_item_before(...) reorders linksToMany relationships
append(...; card(...)) adds linked Cards by canonical identity
Stable Card IDs replace fragile array positions
The adapter maintains JSON:API relationship keys
Bulk relationship deletion restores the original team

scenarios.title: Designate a longtime friend as healthcare proxy
scenarios.intent: Append an authorization record for Margaret's documented longtime friend Helen Mensah, then attach its nested person link in the same atomic program. The contained legal role and linked identity cannot drift apart.
techniques: append(...) adds a record to containsMany
card(...) assigns the nested linksTo person relationship
Contained legal role and linked identity commit atomically
any(...) and all(...) express relationship preconditions
Bulk del(...) removes the complete authorization record

scenarios.pattern: Atomic ICU transfer · contains + links + resources
scenarios.title: Execute a complete ICU transfer command
scenarios.intent: Assert the live admission, move Margaret to ICU, escalate vitals and acuity, replace the care-team link, publish one protocol into two linked collections, prepend a new monitoring instruction, and append the audit event—all or nothing.
techniques: assert(...) validates a multi-field clinical baseline
Nested assignments update scalar and contained values
card(...) replaces a linksTo care-team relationship
prepend(...) adds the highest-priority contained instruction
One resource is appended to two linksToMany collections
The complete cross-structure command commits or rejects atomically
